feedback: T2: smoothing explanation misses all reference ideas (zero probability, unseen bigrams, add one, vocabulary size, probability mass) and is replaced by a generic statement; T2 code has NameError on vocab_size and does not define p_add_one; T3 explanation misses inverse probability, normalised per word, lower is better, surprise.

justification.code: Code: 4 - T1 produces the correct output with the intended method (using Counter and zip); T2 and T3 are essentially the same algorithm but T2 has a runtime NameError (vocab_size undefined) and redefines counters unnecessarily, while T3 gives the correct numeric output but uses a non-intended inline implementation instead of a reusable function like the reference p_add_one. Overall about half the tasks are fully correct with at least one runtime error and wrong output in T2.
justification.explanation: Explanation: 2 - T2 explanation is vague and generic ('makes the language model better and more accurate') and contains none of the reference ideas (zero probability, unseen bigrams, add one, vocabulary size, probability mass); T3 explanation is also generic ('a metric used for language models') and misses all reference ideas (inverse probability, normalised per word, lower is better, surprise).
justification.documentation: Documentation: 3 - Good docstring on the tokens helper and several meaningful comments explaining non-obvious logic (e.g. 'adjacent token pairs are bigrams', 'smoothed probability', perplexity comment); minor gap is that the main probability/perplexity cells lack docstrings.
